apps.name: Beacon Finance
apps.whats_new:
48.21.0  (November 2026)  THE PASTOR'S ROLES WAIT FOR YOUR OK; SECURITY RULES 57
  - Who handles the church's money (Disbursing Officers, Treasurers, Approvers, Auditors) is no longer changed by itself when
    the pastor changes the Roles on the phone. Beacon Finance asks once ("Accept this change now?"), and Portal Finance Roles
    shows the waiting change with Accept the pastor's change. Until it is accepted, everything stays as it was here (the
    pastor's page on the phone shows what Beacon Finance still has). So a change made on a phone alone can never give anyone the
    right to approve or release money.
  - When the church's website needs a newer Beacon Finance (Beacon Pastor → Publish Everything says so), this program says
    "Please update" and sends nothing to the portal until it is updated; reading still works.
  - Online Giving → Copy Security Rules / Make Giving Page Files give rules version 57 (Website Update 106).

apps.name: Beacon Secretary
apps.whats_new:
v4.43.1 - PDFS ON WINDOWS AGAIN; LESS UNUSED CODE; PORTAL COPY = WEBSITE UPDATE 107 (rules stay 57)
  - The Windows setups from the download page (made by GitHub since 2026-11-20) did not include reportlab and pypdf, so
    on a Windows computer installed from them the PDF letters, resolutions and minutes, the baptism and dedication
    certificates and Documents ▸ Import from a PDF could not work. Setups 1.28.44 include them (GitHub's new test step
    found it: the tests run with exactly the setup's libraries).
  - Removed what nothing used any more: the old Dashboard and Statistics pages (dashboard.py, dashboard_v2.py; replaced by
    the new-look Dashboard and Statistics in 4.29 / 4.30, but still loaded at every start), the controller's counts only they
    used, the old Copy Security Rules and Make Portal Files code (Beacon Pastor → Publish Everything does that) with
    HOW_TO_PUBLISH_PORTAL.txt, an unused quick check-in, and other unused helpers and imports. Start-up is a little quicker
    (the charts library is no longer loaded at start). ONLINE_SETUP.txt now says Beacon Pastor publishes the portal.
  - Portal copy = Website Update 107: Beacon Admin on the phone tells someone not allowed that the pastor chooses them (Roles),
    and does not save an activity with a date before today.
